summary: Python 2.3 extended the language with yield expressions, the enumerate() and sum() builtins, and a reworked import system. The set type was added. SSL support improved. This release received long-term maintenance; 2.3.7 was the final patch. Python 2.3 was widely used in the mid-2000s.
notes: Unsupported since 2008-03-11. Last micro 2.3.7. One of the longest-supported 2.x branches before 2.7.
